en.headline: Giant character balloons fill Causeway Bay as Merry Balloon preview continues
en.dek: Free displays of Cookie Monster, Snoopy and other characters run on Pak Sha Road through Sunday as a preview to the December event at Kai Tak.
body: Giant inflatable characters including Cookie Monster, Snoopy and SpongeBob are on display along Pak Sha Road in Causeway Bay as part of the Merry Balloon Hong Kong preview running through Sunday.

The free event, organised by MakeItLoud Marketing, runs from noon to 7pm on Saturday and Sunday after opening from 4pm to 7pm on Friday. Visitors can see the balloons up close alongside carnival-style stalls.

The preview leads into a larger programme in December at Kai Tak Sports Park, where organisers plan a balloon park from 18 to 27 December and a parade on 27 December featuring nearly 20 popular characters.
Admission to the Causeway Bay displays is free. The Hong Kong Tourism Board lists the full schedule on its events calendar.

zh.headline: 巨型角色氣球進駐銅鑼灣 白沙道預熱活動續至周日
zh.dek: Cookie Monster、Snoopy等巨型氣球在銅鑼灣白沙道免費展出至周日，為十二月啟德大型活動預熱。
body: 銅鑼灣白沙道正展出Cookie Monster、Snoopy及海綿寶寶等巨型充氣角色，Merry Balloon Hong Kong預熱活動延續至周日。
由保達創意品牌推廣有限公司主辦的免費活動，周五下午四時至七時開始，周六及周日則由中午十二時至晚上七時。市民可近距離觀看氣球，現場亦設有嘉年華式攤位。
預熱活動為十二月啟德體育園的大型節目舖路，主辦方計劃於十二月十八至二十七日舉行氣球市集，並於二十七日舉行巡遊，屆時將有近二十個受歡迎角色登場。
銅鑼灣展示免費入場。香港旅遊發展局在活動日曆中列出完整時間表。
